description: Binary assertions for /codebase-to-book 9-phase orchestrator static structure check
test_input: codebase to book for d:/KN-Stack — turn this repo into a technical book

assertions.name: parallel_fanout
assertions.check: Phase 1 and 4 fan out parallel Task subagents

assertions.name: one_block_per_turn
assertions.check: executes one block per turn and waits for CEO
assertions.regex: ONE BLOCK PER TURN|EXACTLY ONE block|STOP AND WAIT|WAIT for CEO

assertions.name: ceo_core_gates
assertions.check: thesis / outline / IP sign-off / insights are CEO Core

assertions.name: notebooklm_ingest
assertions.check: P8 builds a NotebookLM notebook and ingests the book

assertions.name: insight_lenses
assertions.check: P9 queries NLM with 5 insight lenses (HELIX/FORGE/Galaxy/ACH/IP)

assertions.name: pseudocode_ip_rule
assertions.check: enforces pseudocode rule / IP audit (no verbatim source)

assertions.name: pipeline_state_ledger
assertions.check: uses _pipeline_state.md ledger as sole communication channel
